original_claim: A secure-by-design Android software framework for emergency healthcare systems that integrates resource prepositioning algorithms and demand-side cost models to maintain operational reliability under infrastructure and funding uncertainty.
original_warrant: Mobile healthcare applications (mHealth) on Android are vital for emergency crews during disasters, yet they lack architectural patterns that handle both strict data security and extreme resource/infrastructure constraints. Bridging these communities enables the development of resilient software architectures that dynamically adapt data synchronization and security protocols based on real-time resource availability and network degradation.
